singleHitEnergy.method: 114 registered cartridges at registry muzzle velocity, one projectile per trace, no manual velocity override. Three actual standing limb fixture paths each at 1 m. ordinaryGlobalBound.assumptions: All valid production flight samples are limited to t_max; drag and existing walls/armor only remove energy.
